func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], reason: String, _ step: (T) async -> Void) async {
  for item in items {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    await client.put(item)
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    await audit.save(item)
  }
}

func use() async throws {
  try await inOrder([], reason: "Each update reads the previous write") { value in print(value) }
}
